chapters.title: Meet Otto
captions: Your agents. Your repos. Your data. Your infrastructure.
Otto: every coding agent, one native Mac app.

chapters.title: Home
captions: Home shows live sessions, dashboards, usage and findings.
Light, dark and right-to-left, one design system.

chapters.title: The command bar
captions: Press ⌘K, type or speak. Otto runs it or answers.
⌥Space calls the bar from anywhere on your Mac.

chapters.title: Agents
captions: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and shells run as real sessions.
Tile up to 15 live terminals, or broadcast one prompt to many.

chapters.title: Threads
captions: Threads run your agents on the structured runtime: plans, commands and diffs stream live.
Approve right where the agent asks, and pick the thread up on your phone.

chapters.title: Goal Loops
captions: Give a goal and acceptance checks.
Goal loops plan, execute and evaluate until every check passes.

chapters.title: Workflows and Scheduled Tasks
captions: Workflows chain agents, approvals and tools.
Scheduled tasks run agents on a cadence and report back.

chapters.title: Personal Agents
captions: A personal agent's Chat is a thread on the same runtime, with its tools.
A main agent delegates to its team and gets their reports back.

chapters.title: Git and AI review
captions: A commit graph with your work in progress and pull requests.
Multi-agent code review turns findings into tracked fixes.

chapters.title: Product and Design Hall
captions: Product unites stories, designs and learnings in one hub.
Frames, 3D, sites and brand kits live in one versioned library.

chapters.title: Vault and Skills Lab
captions: The Vault links your markdown docs into a live knowledge graph.
Skills Lab reviews, benchmarks and sharpens your agent skills.

chapters.title: Database Explorer
captions: MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis and ClickHouse.
Build a query visually and watch agent MCP queries live.

chapters.title: Connections and cloud
captions: SSH, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes, APIs and the web.
Every agent tool call goes through the MCP control plane.

chapters.title: Insights and Usage
captions: Insights turns your activity into key findings.
Usage tracks tokens, cost and machine load.

chapters.title: Rooms · collaborate and recap
captions: Start a room from a live session. The host admits who joins.
Share a screen and talk it through.
Teammates draw on the shared screen, with permission.
Hand over terminal control, and take it back at any time.
With everyone's consent, get a local recap: decisions and action items.

chapters.title: Phone access
captions: Phone access serves Otto to your tailnet only, through Tailscale.
Scan the code, approve the match on your Mac, and your thread continues on the phone.

chapters.title: Everywhere
captions: Snip the screen, bridge Slack and Telegram, and take Otto with you.
Otto. All your agents, one home.
